Subject: MAP draft: SOC 2 package & security review - recapping our discovery call

Hi Olivia / Daniel -

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciated the time. Per our discussion, I’ve drafted a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on the security review / SOC 2 package so we can align on owners and target dates. Attached: SOC2-questionnaire-v1.xlsx and an evidence-index.pdf that lists the documents we typically provide.

MAP milestone: Security review & SOC 2 package delivery
- Objective: Provide Aurelia’s security team with a complete SOC 2 package (questionnaire + evidence bundle) to complete their review and sign-off.
- Deliverables: Completed questionnaire (excel), evidence artifacts (logs, policy docs, architecture diagram), SOC 2 attestation copy or granularity notes.
- Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (sales) / Rishi Malhotra (security liaison)
- Owner (Aurelia): Olivia Chen (security) / Daniel Park (procurement)
- Target due date (for initial delivery): 2026-03-05
- Dependencies: NDA signed (completed), procurement paperwork (in progress), access to sample tenant/trial for smoke tests (optional)
- Next step: Rishi to confirm evidence list & send secure link for evidence upload by 2/27.

Please review and let me know if the owners or dates need adjustment — happy to update the MAP and push to the HubSpot deal. If this looks good, I’ll upload the questionnaire + evidence-index to a secured folder and share the upload link.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), evidence-index.pdf (index of artifacts)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@aurelia.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: SOC 2 package & security review - recapping our discovery call

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. This aligns with what we discussed. A few notes from the Aurelia security side:
- Timeline: We can target receiving the initial package by 2026-03-05, but we will need evidence for data retention and access logs by 2026-03-03 if possible (those are critical for our timeline).
- Evidence specifics: Please include retention policy, sample S3 bucket access logs (last 30 days), IAM role lists, and the architecture diagram showing where customer data is processed and stored.
- Contact for uploads: security@aurelia.com — we prefer a secure transfer (SFTP or pre-signed S3 link). Can you confirm which you’ll provide?
- Question: Do you have a white-labeled SOC 2 report or a statement of scope we can review? If not, a short summary of scope and a timeline for when attestation was obtained will work for now.

We appreciate the quick turnaround. Once we have the package, security will aim to complete an initial read within 5 business days. Procurement will then follow up on commercial terms / SOW redlines.

Regards,
Olivia Chen
Head of Security, Aurelia Tech
olivia.chen@aurelia.com
